sentences.text: Heard the counsel for the petitioner and the respondent no. 3 who has appeared in person.

The present petition has been filed for the following relief:-
"a) to issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of certiorari quashing the impugned 06.06.2022, in Case Crime No.264/2022, under section 498A, 377, 406,
420, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C., Police Station Naini, District Prayagraj on the basis of compromise."

It has been stated in the writ petition that the parties have entered into a compromise and as a consequence of the said compromise, this Court, vide its order dated 18.9.2024 passed in Application U/S 482 No. 36643 of 2023, quashed the charge-sheet and further proceeding in Case crime no. 264 of 2022 against Shakti Pratap Singh, the husband of respondent no. 3.
The petitioner is the brother-in-law of respondent no. 3.
The respondent no. 3 has admitted that the parties have entered into a compromise and states that she does not want to further proceed with Case Crime No.264/2022 instituted by her.

As the main allegations in the first information report are mainly against Shakti Pratap Singh, it would be appropriate and in the interest of justice that the first information report is also quashed in relation to the petitioner.

In light of the order dated 18.9.2024 passed by this Court in Application U/S 482 No. 36643 of 2023, the impugned charge-sheet, cognizance/summoning order and entire proceedings of the aforesaid criminal case against the petitioner - Akhand Pratap Singh are, hereby , quashed.
